answer: Hunt short attestation cycles, not just dense clusters. On the directed graph of who vouches for whom, count tight reciprocal loops: A backs B backs C backs A. A sybil mesh is self-referential, so without outside trust its members must vouch for each other, packing short cycles like iron veins through shale. Honest trust radiates from seeds in near-acyclic fans, hollow of such loops. An identity inside an unusually ferrous tangle of mutual cycles is down-weighted, feeding the non-kin quorum, never a payout.
